findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: README run instructions point to non-existent folder paths and inconsistent URLs/ports

evidence.excerpt: Configure your database connection in `src/PilotUtilityApi.Web/appsettings.json` ... cd src/PilotUtilityApi.Web
Swagger UI: https://localhost:58701/swagger ... Health Check: https://localhost:58401/healthcheck

findings.recommendation: Correct README paths to the actual src/PilotUtiltyApi.Web folder (or rename folders), and align the Swagger/health-check/curl URLs (58701, 58401, 7000, https) with launchSettings.json (http://localhost:58401).

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: Project folder names misspelled (PilotUtiltyApi.*) and inconsistent with csproj names, namespaces and README structure
findings.recommendation: Rename the src/ and test/ folders to PilotUtilityApi.* to match project names and namespaces (dotnet_style_namespace_match_folder is enabled), then update the .sln paths and README.
